description: SSRF URL guard — Check a URL before your server or agent fetches it: blocks non-http schemes, cloud metadata (169.254.169.254, fd00:ec2::254, 100.100.100.200), loopback/private/link-local/CGNAT/reserved IPs incl. IPv4-mapped IPv6 and NAT64, obfuscated IP forms (decimal, hex, octal, short), userinfo tricks, backslash and control-character parser confusion, internal hostnames (.internal, .local, kubernetes.default.svc), wildcard/rebinding DNS services (nip.io, sslip.io), internal service ports, and resolves A/AAAA over DNS-over-HTTPS to catch public names that point inside (plus low-TTL rebinding risk). Returns BLOCK/CAUTION/ALLOW with flags and advice. Never fetches the URL. Params: url; resolve=0 to skip DNS. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_ssrf_check
